content.comment_body: Rather than hiding the [product_name] from users, I'd like to make its display and keypad accessible on the outside of a control box, while keeping the I/O ports hidden. Are there any brackets that simplify installation and offer some IP protection, or are there any relevant expansion modules? TIA [user_name]
Hi [user_name], You may want to check [url] for possible mounting solutions and accessories. Greetinx, [user_name]
I was browsing the main menu for the [product_name] range but didn't notice the accessories section on the main product page. Appreciate you highlighting this!

Hello, If you use the new [product_name] [article_no], you can also utilize the [product_name] [product_name] Operator Device. This HMI device is designed for newer [product_name] modules and can be mounted on cabinet doors, for example. The display may present similar info as the main unit but can also show distinct operator data versus service data. Refer to [url] for further details or contact your local [company_name] representative. Hope this helps. Regards
I've seen the new [product_name] Operator Device recently, but we still need to use some older [product_name] units we have in stock. Thanks.

Hi, The panel mounts I purchased from [company_name] included frosted plastic covers—please check if this could be an issue for you. Since the [product_name] fits standard DIN rail size, mounts from other manufacturers also fit well.
Hi! I've also used [product_name] enclosures. More details here: [url]
There are versions available with glass and with buttons—often using a rubber pad that fits the button panel. I accidentally ordered the wrong type the first time.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants seek practical solutions to make the [product_name] display and keypad accessible from outside a control box while protecting I/O for safety and appearance. Information about compatible mounting accessories is not easily found, leading to confusion and incorrect orders.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want clear, simple options for external mounting of the [product_name] display, with secure protection and compatibility details, ideally with accessories that are easy to locate and select.
